sections.brief: Herzl's diary: Hechler's Cappadocia-to-Suez entry (secondary, unchecked) and the authentic 1898 note of a planned request to the sultan for land from the Egyptian frontier to the Euphrates (Pipes 1994, Tagebuecher vol. 2 p. 650), never made, never policy; English wording unchecked; correction of rd1 s04 and Book 4 'fabrication'; El-Arish, East Africa (295-178), Mesopotamia. Figure: compare

Zionist Organization statement to the Paris Peace Conference, 3 Feb 1919: signatories, 'historic title', boundary schedule (south of Sidon, Hermon, west of the Hejaz Railway to Aqaba, south by agreement with Egypt), water rationale, 'non-Jewish communities'; what the powers drew instead (23 Dec 1920 convention, 7 Mar 1923 line, Transjordan memorandum 16 Sep 1922); not Nile-Euphrates; the Litani misattribution. Figure: compare

Jabotinsky: Iron Wall (method, not borders); Revisionist Union Paris 1925 'both sides of the Jordan'; 1931 resolution; NZO 1935 and anti-Peel; Betar (Riga 1923; 70,000 in 1934); 'The East Bank of the Jordan' (1929/1930); Irgun emblem; Herut 1948, Revisionist list 0.7%; minority claim; Likud 1977 drops east bank; Jordan treaty, MFA 2023 and King Abdullah's 'alternative homeland' position. Figure: time

Peel map July 1937 (17% Jewish state, Arab state with Transjordan, British zone); 20th Congress (unacceptable, but negotiate), NZO and Arab Higher Committee rejections; Woodhead/Cmd 5893; Ben-Gurion to Amos 5 Oct 1937: undisputed 'beginning'/'liberate the entire country' and Negev passages; disputed sentence with both readings (Teveth/Morris vs Karsh; Morris 2011 'red herring'); Pappé misquote distinguished; June 1938 JAE remark (secondary); programme vs posture as argument. Figure: compare
